def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix island label variants (extra spaces / case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # flipper_length_mm: fix sign errors (negatives are magnitude typos)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # body_mass_g: numbers written as text, possibly with commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # sex: missing means unknown; leave as NaN (do not guess)
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    d = d[d['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235)]
    means = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
